status: Predeclared before new training/results; retrospective research, no untouched holdout
target: E[Y * 1(Y >= 8)] per fixture; fixture contributions summed for DGW, NOT a GW quantile/probability
features: Unchanged current HGB BASE+FX; no new xG package to confound objectives
training: Only earlier seasons, outcomes available before first cutoff, frozen models during season
reference: Frozen 50/50 Ridge+Extra Trees; also compare HGB and Ridge
primary: GW38 net season points; same original GW1-4 opening and inherited actual state
secondary: weekly top20 haul precision/recall and NDCG
top10 within predeadline cheap and short-history strata
captain actual points and haul rate
short_history: fewer than 12 observed past fixture rows; not a true debut-season indicator
selection: For 2022 onward, select among reference and 4 new candidates on earlier seasons only: mean gain minus .25 SD; keep reference within 2 points of best
limitations: Tail scores and blends are decision scores, not calibrated total expected points
Same incomplete historical registration/injury/price/calendar proxies as current experiment
Summed fixture-tail expectations are not expected weekly tail nor probability of weekly haul
Old frozen baseline/model family already studied; all comparisons exploratory
